claim.claim-text: 2. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one tank comprises an open top configured to enable access to each of the plurality of computers.

3. The system of claim 1, wherein a flow of the dielectric liquid coolant between the plurality of computers is restricted, thereby enhancing the flow of the dielectric liquid coolant through the plurality of computers.
4. The system of claim 1, wherein the dielectric liquid coolant is in a range of 90 degrees F. and 100 degrees F.
5. The system of claim 1, wherein each of the plurality of computers comprise at least one memory.
6. The system of claim 1, wherein the plurality of computers are connected to a computing network.
7. The system of claim 1, wherein the plurality of computers are configured to receive a request to provide computing resources.
8. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one tank is configured to reduce a flow of coolant around each of the plurality of computers.
9. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one tank is configured to restrict a flow of the dielectric liquid coolant between the plurality of computers.
10. The system of claim 1, wherein the plurality of computers are oriented vertically.
11. The system of claim 1, wherein heat is transferred from the plurality of computers to the dielectric liquid coolant without piping going through the plurality of computers.
12. The system of claim 2, wherein at least a portion of the dielectric liquid coolant flows from a bottom of the at least one tank to the open top.
13. The system of claim 12, wherein the coolant outlet is located at a top portion of the at least one tank.

14. The system of claim 13, wherein at least a portion of a fluid flow of the dielectric liquid coolant within the at least one tank flows from a top of the at least one tank to the bottom of the at least one tank.
15. The system of claim 14, wherein the at least one tank includes a rectangular tank.

16. The system of claim 14, wherein a fluid flow of the dielectric liquid coolant entering the at least one tank through the coolant inlet is initially directed through a volume of dielectric liquid coolant at a bottom side of the at least one tank, through the plurality of computers, and into a volume of the dielectric liquid coolant at the top of the at least one tank.
18. The system of claim 17, wherein the collection piping is fluidly coupled to the pump.
